meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Matched evaluated HTTP 503, opaque trace ID validation, safe public replies, and saved-turn replay to the Support controller and observability guide.

auth.review_note: Checked the browser and actor owner hash, CSRF form validation, and the database retry identity check.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed provider parsing and existing product checkout and verified-order tests. A typed provider refusal preserves the existing numeric error for shop checkout.

content.review_note: Compared published Support guidance with the contact link and validated reference in the widget. Campaign content and payment flows were preserved by the merge.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed the one streamed audit SELECT, strict authenticated response and PDO cleanup alongside campaign booking persistence and protected storage.

google-tags.review_note: Compared the documented storefront helper behavior after the shared layout and frontend skill added a Support transcript detail.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed sanitized provider failures and private booking responses against the existing dynamic response guard.

interface.review_note: Compared the live-region announcement, keyboard recovery, Contact Us flow, and viewport behavior with shared layout and design guidance.

mail.review_note: Compared the owner login and notice documentation against the existing controller and confirmed the dashboard count remains a read-only operation.

mcp-clients.review_note: Checked the merged Integrations guide against the local MCP client controller and form. The owner issues and revokes a paid-sales grant, and the trusted STDIO client receives it through its process environment.

media.review_note: Checked retained campaign file descriptors and protected streaming against Media Library behavior. Booking authorization is scoped to the frozen private manifest.

operator-help.review_note: Compared the published Support contact guide with the accessible opaque reference, clean error reply, and reload behavior.

public-mcp.review_note: Compared the regenerated route associations with Public MCP and A2UI. The Dashboard read stays on the authenticated database bridge.

remote-commerce.review_note: Reviewed the shared checkout layout and existing recovery paths after the Support transcript added an opaque failure reference.

sales-channels.review_note: Compared the MediaService additions with the Merchant Feed and product image inspection contracts. Header choices are filtered only for the owner authored editor, and catalogue image eligibility and feed URLs retain their existing resolution.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed the browser fixture with the repository release gate. It intercepts synthetic failures and never submits any production agent request.
